text: Accepted OnFolderAdded ORs SentMail, Archive or Trash into its local folderFlags when the folder lies under those special folders, then compares that mask with searchFolderFlag. This local classification does not call SetFlags on the source folder. Preserve the distinction between a search-scope capability mask and persistent folder metadata when naming or refactoring this code. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Smart-folder descendant flags classify search scope without changing persisted folder flags
